what_it_is.prose: Tata Advanced Systems Limited (TASL) is the aerospace & defence flagship of the Tata Group, incorporated in 2006 and operational from 2007. Headquartered in Hyderabad with facilities at Vemagal (Karnataka) and Pune, TASL is India's largest private-sector defence & aerospace OEM. It operates multiple joint ventures: (1) Tata Lockheed Martin Aero Structures Ltd (TLMA) — global single source for C-130J/LM100J empennages shipped to Lockheed's Marietta (Georgia) FAL; (2) Tata Boeing Aerospace Ltd (TBAL) — global single source for AH-64 Apache helicopter fuselages, with 300th fuselage delivered by late 2025; (3) Tata Sikorsky JV — produces S-92 helicopter cabins since 2013 (first indigenous cabin delivered 24 Oct 2013); (4) Airbus H125 helicopter Final Assembly Line at Vemagal — India's first private-sector helicopter FAL, inaugurated 17 February 2026. TASL also broke ground on 18 Dec 2025 on a new Defence MRO facility supporting Lockheed Martin C-130J operations in India. In land systems, TASL is the production partner for the DRDO-developed WhAP 8x8 Wheeled Armoured Platform (India's first amphibious wheeled infantry combat vehicle), with first batch delivered to Royal Moroccan Army on 24 Dec 2025 (TASL's first major armoured vehicle export) and Infantry Protected Vehicles based on WhAP delivered to Indian Army from April 2025. TASL manufactures the Akash Army Launcher (AAL) — a mobile launcher system capable of transporting and launching up to three Akash medium-range SAMs in single or salvo mode.
